result.title: Zero-Shot Weight-Space Programming Across a Difficulty-Graded Ladder of Two-Player Games
result.summary: Weight-space programming sets every weight of a feed-forward network by hand, from an explicit specification of the desired computation, with no gradient descent and no training data anywhere in the construction. We ask how far a large language model can carry this practice, zero-shot, across games of deliberately increasing difficulty. We design a four-rung ladder (Nim, tic-tac-toe, two sizes of Connect Four, and a chess endgame) spanning four axes of difficulty, and build a second, independent network at each rung, using a structurally unrelated game at matched difficulty, to separate what a rung's finding says about the difficulty level from what it says about the one game used to measure it. Ten networks are built and independently verified. Six admit a complete, non-statistical proof of correctness against an independent oracle. The chess-endgame rung is exact where correctness is cheap, move legality and, in one network, an exact one-ply mate detector, and collapses where it is expensive, composing a multi-move mating plan, from 84.1-100% success at the one-ply tactics it was built to get right down to 0.57-9.13% in full adversarial play; its replicate shows this collapse is an order of magnitude less severe under a shorter required plan and exact rather than heuristic safety checks. The standard-sized rung confirms, by holding hand-set evaluation weights fixed and adding only shallow search, that the remaining gap is an architectural ceiling rather than a matter of engineering effort, and this exact collapse reproduces across two structurally unrelated games. We release all ten networks, their independent oracles, construction-cost measurements, and a cold-prompt protocol for a future cross-model comparison

AI.brief_summary: 论文让 LLM 零样本「手写」前馈网络的全部权重，在由 Nim、井字棋、两种规模 Connect Four 与国际象棋残局组成的四级难度阶梯上，为每级再配一个结构无关的同难度游戏，共构建十个网络并独立验证；其中六个可给出完整正确性证明，棋类残局在一层战术判断上精确，但在多步将杀规划中性能骤降。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「难度阶梯＋同难度异游戏复制」以及「单步精确、多步组合崩溃」的评测设计，可能为核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真正支撑多步推理与长度泛化提供对照思路，但任务与视觉模态相距较远，需较多核查。
